linkedin:
Most small businesses don't lose customers because of their product. They lose them because nobody replied in time.

A WhatsApp message at 9pm. A lead from the website that sat in an inbox. An invoice that never got chased.

I work with local businesses in Mauritius every week, and the pattern is always the same. The work is great. The admin around the work is what breaks.

That's why I wrote a practical guide to AI automation for local businesses, with the seven processes I'd automate first: lead follow up, enquiry replies, bookings and reminders, invoicing, reporting dashboards, social media drafts and CRM updates.

My advice is simple. Pick one process. Map it. Automate the repetitive parts. Measure the result. Then expand.

And keep humans in charge of sensitive decisions, complaints and key relationships. Automate the admin, not the relationship.

I also cover what the Mauritius Data Protection Act 2017 means for any automation that touches customer data.
